article.title: Governing Board of information utility.
article.content: The Board may, for ensuring that an information utility takes into account the objectives sought to be achieved under this Code, require every information utility to set up a governing board, with such number of independent members, as may be specified by regulations.

212Governing Board of information utility.

Section 212 · Part IV · Chapter V · pages 135–136 of the Act

The Board may, for ensuring that an information utility takes into account the objectives sought to be achieved under this Code, require every information utility to set up a governing board, with such number of independent members, as may be specified by regulations.
